paragraphs.text: Kalitas was a dwarven town in the Crimson Peaks of Sarpadia , on the world of Dominaria .

After the fall of the dwarven empire of the Sarpadian Mountains in the north, the orcs and goblins swept south into Icatia and the Crimson Peaks . The location of Kalitas, close to the border of Icatia, meant that it was directly exposed to raiders. The town was attacked, and all its buildings were burned down, a sole dwarven man the only survivor of the attack. He was found two days later by Reod Dai , Melelki , Tamun and Sekena . Although they tried to console him and bring him with them, he refused, and they had to move on to Havenwood without him.
